next_stage: Complete and independently audit the two active RX J2129 production gates: the full X4 MOS2+pn response package and all 21 frozen two-band HST H2 centroids. In parallel, execute the checksum-locked ESO 325-G004 acquisition and observable-rank protocol. E325 has one public level-2 MUSE science cube, public 18,882-second F814W and 4,800-second F475W HST imaging, a 2.95-arcsecond extended ring inside the published 4-arcsecond dynamics support, and published sensitivity to radial magnification. This authorizes only five exact science products and a four-direction image-level Jacobian. E325 remains outside the ten-system ceiling unless at least three >=3-sigma lens-response singular directions survive every source-light, lens-light, PSF, shear, mass-sheet, baryonic, regularization, mask, finite-difference, synthetic-injection, and held-out-visit control, and at least three numerical MUSE bins with covariance overlap them. The structural ceiling remains 3/10; no gravity response, R2 fit, or new force law is authorized.

milestones.name: pilot integrity
milestones.outcome: Recenter all three local RELICS ensembles on verified BCG coordinates, identify their rerunnable lens inputs or document model-product dependence, and attach declared stellar M/L uncertainty.
milestones.advance_threshold: At least one non-disturbed engineering system satisfies the complete per-system schema and the 3+3 overlap count.
milestones.failure_response: If none passes, do not fit a response; replace the pilot source or revise the observable design. A2537 alone cannot pass because its source flags a disturbed state.

milestones.name: structural inner-lensing identifiability
milestones.outcome: Audit whether any current system can supply three independent radial Weyl-response samples before constructing a nuisance-marginalized Jacobian.
milestones.advance_threshold: At least one non-disturbed pilot has three strict inner image positions, a structural radial-rank upper bound of at least 3, and at least four family-wide positional degrees of freedom after source-coordinate marginalization.
milestones.failure_response: Invoked: all ten systems fail. Do not build their full Jacobians; start R1A.2 and retain these data only as provenance, nuisance-model, and lower-rank controls.

milestones.name: residual-blind replacement qualification
milestones.outcome: Build a machine-readable, residual-blind audit of at least 30 unique BCG hosts, or a source-by-source hard-shortfall certificate, and identify replacements with resolved BCG dynamics, baryonic profiles, and at least three strict central image radii on common support. MACS J1206 remains a structural promotion but its frozen public-cube consistency gates fail. RX J2129 is the second structural promotion: its frozen four-bin public-MUSE reconstruction passes the baseline checks, so strict-readiness preparation may begin while the host inventory continues.
milestones.advance_threshold: At least two non-disturbed replacement systems pass the frozen structural gate: at least 3 dynamics bins, at least 3 strict inner image positions, structural radial-rank upper bound >=3, sufficient family-wide positional degrees of freedom, verified common center/support, and public observable-level lens inputs.
milestones.threshold_result: Met by MACS J1206 and RX J2129. The separate count boundary is also met: exhausting the complete 32-BCG Loubser sample adds 27 unique hosts after five overlaps, raising the cumulative inventory to 45. This authorizes strict-readiness acquisition, not a Jacobian or gravity fit.
milestones.completion_threshold: Reach 30 unique source-screened hosts or publish a source-by-source hard-shortfall certificate while preserving the two structural promotions.
milestones.failure_response: After each cycle, record every host and exclusion reason. If fewer than two systems qualify, search the next independent resolved-BCG sample without loosening the gate. Three consecutive unsuccessful cycles or seven active research days triggers a premise/data-availability rethink and a hard-shortfall report.

milestones.name: five-system acquisition checkpoint
milestones.outcome: Complete and independently audit RX J2129 X4 and H2. In parallel, receive the five immutable E325 products and test whether its extended arcs yield three nuisance-marginalized radial response modes plus three overlapping numerical dynamics bins. Neither branch may be promoted from engineering output, pixel count, or a published GR/gamma posterior.
milestones.advance_threshold: At least five strict R1-ready systems with no data-quality exclusion.
milestones.failure_response: If fewer than two systems are added in one completed acquisition cycle, document the specific public-data obstruction and search a replacement resolved-dynamics sample before another cycle.

milestones.name: ten-system freeze
milestones.outcome: Freeze system identities, radial masks, covariance treatment, and grouped validation splits before inspecting any gravity residual.
milestones.advance_threshold: At least ten strict R1-ready systems.
milestones.failure_response: After three acquisition cycles or seven active research days, whichever comes first, stop the unification fit if ten systems cannot be assembled and report R2 as empirically unidentifiable with public data.

milestones.name: theory-free response test
milestones.outcome: Cross-validate separate dynamical and Weyl-potential reconstructions on the frozen same-object sample.
milestones.advance_threshold: Retain one field only if it closes at least 50% of each held-out benchmark gap; retain two potentials only if the second response is independently required.
milestones.failure_response: If neither response is identifiable, stop rather than add another force-law variant.
